title: 计算形状的面积
problem_statement_md:
给定的代码将两个数字作为输入，并调用**Shape**类的静态面积**area**()方法，输出形状的面积（高度乘以宽度）。

为了使代码工作，你需要定义**Shape**类，以及静态`area()`方法，它返回两个参数的乘积。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Static Methods[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The given code takes 2 numbers as input and calls the static [b]area[/b]() method of the [b]Shape[/b] class, to output the area of the shape, which is equal to the height multiplied by the width.
To make the code work, you need to define the Shape class, and the static area() method, which should return the multiplication of its two arguments.
[note]Use the [b]@staticmethod[/b] decorator to define a static method.[/note]
hint_md: 使用`@staticmethod`装饰器来定义一个静态方法。
